'''Vergost''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was a [[Speciesism|Human supremacist]] and viewed [[alien]]s as a blight on the galaxy that needed to to be eliminated. Although respected for his effectiveness by the Moffs, Vergost's obsessions limited his advancement throughout Imperial ranks. However, one day he got an opportunity to vindicate himself and prove the worth of his genocidal beliefs to the Empire. Stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], Commander Vergost was tasked to create chemicals inside an extermination factory where he would plan to use it to [[Death/Legends|kill]] all the [[Evocii]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in order to gain an alliance with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. His plan was interrupted by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] individual who came to prevent the commander from unleashing the chemicals. Vergost and his guards engaged the individual, but were all beaten.

==Behind the scenes==
===Gameplay alternatives===
In the Nar Shaddaa side mission "Extermination," upon being defeated, Vergost insists he knows of other extermination factories the Empire had established on Nar Shaddaa, despite [[Kalda Biss]] arguing for his execution. The player(s) can either:<ref name="Extermination" />
*Take Vergost into custody, earning light side points. Biss vows to personally conduct his interrogation and punches him in the face for offending her.
*Execute Vergost, earning dark side points.
